policies.text: A product line achieves commercial deployment authorization when post-purchase maintenance benchmarks are met.
An offering is approved for civic transit listings if compliance with municipal protection norms is established and the producer carries general liability protection of at least $2,000,000.
Enrollment in municipal purchasing channels is granted to any product line approved for civic transit listings.
A healthcare manufacturer satisfies quality system criteria if the supplier possesses an active ISO 13485 credential.
Compliance with municipal protection norms is established for a vendor with commercial deployment authorization provided an official audit record confirms zero critical defects.
An electronic component obtains green eco-labeling if recycled material content equals or exceeds 40 percent.

Equipment satisfies post-purchase maintenance benchmarks if the producer maintains a regional spare parts inventory of at least $150,000 alongside a manufacturer warranty period of no less than 12 months.
A distributor achieves preferred vendor status if annual revenue exceeds $10,000,000 or if a five-year clean track record is verified.
